name: Aztec Connect RollupProcessorV3 numRealTxs settlement gap
summary: Decoder.decodeProof() proves whole 32-tx inner-rollup chunks while processDepositsAndWithdrawals() settles only numRealTxs txs, and numRealTxs sits outside the hashed header, so a deposit in a later slot of the deprecated permissionless RollupProcessorV3 was minted on L2 without its L1 deposit ever being debited.
notes: The third and final pre-incident Upgraded event selected RollupProcessorV3 implementation 0x7d657ddcf7e2a5fd118dc8a6ddc3dc308adc2728.

Aztec's incident report gives the seven exact quantities and a $2.19 million incident-time aggregate. The six ERC-20 transfers reproduce in the exploit receipt; the ETH withdrawal reproduces in the call trace.
